text_elements.text: Check voltage of corresponding module. Refer to EVB-131, "Component Inspection".
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: YES >> Replace Li-ion battery controller. Refer to EVB-214, "LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: NO >> Replace corresponding module. Refer to EVB-246, "FRONT MODULE STACK : Disassembly and Assembly".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: NO >> Replace module. Refer to EVB-246, "FRONT MODULE STACK : Disassembly and Assembly".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Power switch ON and wait for 10 seconds or more.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The removed service plug must always be carried in a pocket of the responsible worker or placed in the tool box during the procedure to prevent the plug from being connected by mistake.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Be sure to wear insulating protective equipment consisting of glove, shoes, face shield and glasses before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Never allow workers other than the responsible person to touch the vehicle containing high voltage parts. To keep others from touching the high voltage parts, these parts must be covered with an insulating sheet except when using them.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Never  bring  the  vehicle  into  the  READY  status  with  the  service  plug  removed  unless  otherwise instructed in the Service Manual. A malfunction may occur if this is not observed.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Check 'Self Diagnostic Result' of systems other than 'HV BAT' if any DTC is detected.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: YES >> After performing trouble diagnosis of detected DTC, GO TO 2.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Disconnect high voltage. Refer to GI-33, "How to Disconnect High Voltage".
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Remove Li-ion battery. Refer to EVB-194, "Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Remove battery pack upper case. Refer to EVB-204, "BATTERY PACK UPPER CASE : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: 3.CHECK HARNESS BETWEEN MODULE AND LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Identify the malfunctioning module based on detected DTC.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Disconnect module harness connector and Li-ion battery controller harness connector.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Refer to below table and check the continuity between corresponding module and Li-ion battery controller.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check voltage of corresponding module. Refer to EVB-134, "Component Inspection".
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: YES >> Replace Li-ion battery controller. Refer to EVB-214, "LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: NO >> Replace corresponding module. Refer to EVB-246, "FRONT MODULE STACK : Disassembly and Assembly".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: NO >> Replace module. Refer to EVB-246, "FRONT MODULE STACK : Disassembly and Assembly".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Power switch ON and wait for 10 seconds or more.
text_elements.label: list_item

Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
